title: A Gesture, Considered
hook: A gift begins with a thought.
message: Meaningful gifting begins with attention, not a claim about a perfect product.

shots.visual: Close opening on a blank matte-ivory typographic card with plenty of negative space. Use no physical gift box; typography alone implies consideration. Place approved PERLA product image as a small partial reveal in a secondary frame, intact. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.onScreenText: A gift begins with a thought.
shots.transition: Cut from black; fade in text over 180ms.

shots.visual: Scale up the approved PERLA 50ML UNISEX original product image from a wide ivory background with subtle 2D movement. Keep bottle and label undistorted; no invented packaging or bow. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: Position the same PERLA original centrally with a separate unbranded paper-shaped graphic in the background. The graphic is editorial only, not an included card or service. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Soft 180ms cross-dissolve on shot boundary; product marks remain stable.

shots.visual: End on the original PERLA image and approved Lavish square logo as distinct, separate tiles with the CTA text below, not over the bottle label. English creative version with restrained editorial typography.
shots.transition: Hold final composition and fade to matte at exactly 15000ms.

subtitles.text: A gift begins with a thought.

caption: A gifting concept anchored in the verified PERLA 50ML UNISEX product. No gift box, bundle, wrapping service, discount or occasion-based demand is asserted. Concept POC / Mock. Explore Lavish Perfumes. No product-performance claim.
